name: Story Circle (8 steps)
license_note: Widely-taught 8-step cycle; prompts are original prose.

beats.name: You (comfort zone)
beats.prompt: Who is the character in their zone of comfort?

beats.name: Need
beats.prompt: What do they want that comfort cannot give?

beats.name: Go
beats.prompt: How do they enter an unfamiliar situation?

beats.name: Search
beats.prompt: How do they adapt to the new rules?

beats.name: Find
beats.prompt: Where do they get what they wanted?

beats.name: Take
beats.prompt: What heavy price does the finding exact?

beats.name: Return
beats.prompt: How do they come back to the familiar?

beats.name: Change
beats.prompt: How are they now capable of what they were not?
